high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post with a black background and white text. The post describes an intense storm in Chennai, India, with heavy rainfall reaching 50 mm per hour. The text mentions that the storm is moving from south to north and that it is one of the fastest-moving storms of its kind in the century. It also notes that the sound and light effects during the storm are frightening. Below the text, there are two weather maps. The left map shows a satellite view of Chennai with various colored areas indicating different levels of rainfall intensity.
